While the suitcase itself is rendered with high fidelity (correct geometry, texture, and lighting), the structural collapse of the supporting bicycles severely impacts the overall authenticity score.

The authenticity penalty is justified by the visible mechanical impossibility in the handlebar cluster, not just minor texture issues.
